content.title: West Arvada Dog Park
content.summary: The West Arvada Dog Park, located at 17975 W. 64th Parkway, is a volunteer-operated facility on City-owned land, funded entirely through donations. The City has no plans to close the park and is proposing an ordinance to clarify the management and operational procedures for the park and surrounding amenities. Community support is encouraged for the park's upkeep and improvements, with a dog license required for usage.
content.body:
![West Arvada Dog Park ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=1218 "West Arvada Dog Park ")

1. [The City has no intention to close the West Arvada Dog Park](#tab444c7103-a5ce-4222-abd4-2939f6b8915f_0)

The City’s Utilities Department owns the land where the West Arvada Dog Park, Bird’s Nest Disc Golf Course, and Arvada-Blunn Reservoir are located; property purchased through the City’s Water Fund. The ordinance proposed for City Council approval on Tuesday, March 3 would repeal and reenact Chapter 66, Parks and Recreation, of the Arvada City Code, and provide clear policy about the use and management of these properties.

The City is not removing any of these amenities and has no intention to close the dog park. The ordinance sets an operational procedure that is currently lacking in the City Code and acknowledges the authority of the City Manager, in following applicable laws, for any changes to the use of these properties. This direction was not previously codified within the City Code and its inclusion in this ordinance ensures clear continuity of service and management of these spaces.

Visit the [Water Treatment Plant Replacement page](/886) for information on potential sites for the construction of a new pump station southeast of the Arvada-Blunn Reservoir.

## General Information

The West Arvada Dog Park is located at [17975 W. 64th Parkway in Arvada](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4vn6tF3rqQCWXECM9). The West Arvada Dog Park is a "Special Use" park operated by volunteers on City-owned property. The park is funded 100% through donations.

Happy, healthy dogs make a happy, healthy community. When dogs have the chance to exercise, socialize and play, they become better members of the community. Incidents of animal surrender, animal control citations, and other unwanted behavior diminishes. Please note: a dog license is required for dog park usage.

**For the most up to date information about the dog park,**[**visit the West Arvada Dog Park Facebook page**](https://www.facebook.com/WestArvadaDogPark/timeline)**.**

## Off-Leash Dogs in Arvada

[Section 14-53 of the City Code of Ordinances](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIICOOR_CH14AN_ARTIIIOWRE_S14-54RULA) prohibits dogs from being off leash on any street or public place in the city, including any of the City's parks, trails or open spaces. There is an exception in the code for off-leash dog parks like West Arvada Dog Park.

Visit the [City's Animal Management Unit page](/199) for information about animal management issues, including who to contact for urgent and non-urgent issues.

    

## How You Can Support the Dog Park

Community support and participation are critical in the overall success of the dog park. Visit the [West Arvada Dog Park Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/WestArvadaDogPark/) to learn more.

[Email us](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#be9ec9dfdacec9d1d1d8fed9d3dfd7d290ddd1d3) for volunteer opportunities or if you have questions about the dog park.

You can help make improvements and additions to the dog park which will be enjoyed by our canine friends.
